author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.55 shipped: Energy settings name roles, not brands; no house-specific entity defaults in code
summary: Energy settings name roles, not brands; no house-specific entity defaults in code
why: URA's energy code shipped this house's entity IDs as built-in defaults, so a second home would silently target entities that don't exist and quietly do nothing, and a SPAN rename here silently broke a control path. Every default becomes a role-named setting copied into this house once from the entity registry, labels name roles not brands, mapping edits reload on save, and an hourly check surfaces configured-but-missing entities.
implications: Shipped EC-HOUSE-ENTITY-DEFAULTS-1 at v5.103.55; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.55.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If any energy role resolves differently on this house after upgrade, or a Repairs issue names an entity that exists.
